title: Ur-Nashet, the night of the binding
premise: the player's first battle is 800 years early, in a city that no longer exists
rules_that_differ: chariots, no requisition, no permadeath, no forge; one weapon each, no repair
what_it_teaches: teaches: movement, terrain cost, the weapon triangle -- nothing else
the_turn: ends with the city taken and its patron written into a book; the player did that. THE NAME IS NEVER SHOWN: the scribe's hand covers the page, the angle is wrong, the rain is on it. The player performs the founding crime without learning what was written.

title: The scribes' quarter
premise: the First Register is copied for the first time, under deadline
rules_that_differ: protect the copyists; a page is lost and the game does not tell you which
what_it_teaches: teaches: the epithet ledger, by showing you a clerk recording deeds
the_turn: the missing name enters the world here, as an accident nobody notices

title: The last court of the Long Reign
premise: the church that held the realm together, on the day it stopped being believed
rules_that_differ: a defence with no reinforcements and no supply; the state simply runs out
what_it_teaches: teaches: what the pact layer costs, by letting you spend it freely and lose anyway
the_turn: the only flashback the player can lose without a restart; losing is the ending
